issue: UNESCO Earmarked Activities donor stream has NO carry-forward fund pattern (e.g. no 196EAR4142). Other UNESCO budget streams have these: 196RES4142 (Emergency Assistance carryforward), 196IAC4042 (International Assistance carryforward). The absence forces field offices with deliverables that span the biennium boundary to keep posting on the (now expired in spirit) predecessor biennium fund 196EAR4042, depleting its 2026 AVC pool and triggering FMAVC005 blocks on SES / MIRO / F110 postings.

source: FM-AVC engine (FMAVCT + FMAFMAP013500109) vs PS-AVC engine (BPJA + COSP + PRPS) cross-engine reconciliation
issue: Structural model gap: UNESCO runs two AVC engines (FM-AVC per (FUND, FUNDSCTR, CommItem); PS-AVC per WBS) at different granularities. They disagree at biennium close-out on TYPE 101-112 donor funds because revenue is loaded onto a placeholder FIPEX (REVENUE) that does not match the AVC-derivation range, while consumption posts to operational FIPEX (11, 13, 20, 30, ...). Result: FM-AVC blocks SES / MIRO / F110 postings while the PS-AVC project pool reports healthy. This is a configuration-level defect (FIPEX-derivation strategy + revenue-loading procedure), not a bug in custom code.
impact: 2,005 buckets at risk UNESCO-wide (488 Tier 1 BOTH engines blocking + 1,517 Tier 2 FM-only blocking) per the 2026-05-01 class-detector run. Growth rate +4.1%/month measured Mar 31 -> Apr 28 2026 (+60 Tier 2 buckets in 4 weeks). Every biennium-end cycle on every Earmarked donor fund stream is structurally exposed. Symptom: red FMAVC005 / FI 026 abend at SES posting, invoice posting, or F110/F-53 payment time — independent of FBZP, BCM, or workflow configuration.
workaround: Per affected bucket: (a) FMAVCREINIT on (RLDNR=9H, RFIKRS=UNES, RYEAR=current, RFUND=<legacy>); OR (b) load supplementary AVC budget on operational FIPEX via FMBB/FMX1; OR (c) close legacy fund (TYPE 104 -> 106) once successor is active. Pre-carry-forward gate: run inc5638_fm_ps_avc_misalignment.py against latest Gold DB and triage every Tier 1/Tier 2 bucket before the CF run.

monitoring_blindness_2026_05_03.finding: UNESCO primary Project Manager dashboard (YPS8) and budget/expenditure report (YFM1) use the same IS_COMMITMENT_ITEM_IN_AVC filter as FM-AVC. Therefore the monitoring tool is as blind as the engine. Project Managers cannot pre-empt INC-005638-class incidents from YPS8 alone.
monitoring_blindness_2026_05_03.implication: Any monitoring/alerting strategy must use a per-FIPEX detector (e.g., committed_vs_available_detector.py) INSTEAD OF or IN ADDITION TO YPS8/YFM1, because YPS8/YFM1 will not surface the gap. This is independent of fixes G/H/I/F — even after fixing AVC config, the reports themselves should be reviewed.

central_narrative_2026_05_02: AVC absence/misconfiguration is the UPSTREAM root cause. Everything downstream (FB01 batches, closure protocols, workplan reprogramming, MULESOFT mappings, PO redirects) are symptoms or transport layers. SAP knew about the open commitments but had no guardian to enforce the constraint. The structural fix priority is therefore: FIX-G1 (granular AVC per-FIPEX) + FIX-G2 (exclude REVENUE from TC pool) + FIX-G3 (enable AVC for non-Earmarked TYPEs that need it) + FIX-H (remove REVENUE preservation in YCL_YPS8_BCS_BL). FIX-F Meta-AVC is the long-term strategic enhancement that ALSO adds cross-engine FM<->PS consistency check at every posting. FIX-A MULESOFT is deprecated. FIX-D/E/B are mitigations of symptoms.

title: v001_change_matrix.csv row 1 (SEPA Cdtr/StrtNm → FPAYP/REF01) contradicts code reading
summary: Matrix row 1 binds /SEPA_CT_UNES Cdtr/StrtNm to FPAYP/REF01 with rationale 'CM005 line 109 writes Cdtr to FPAYP-REF01'. Direct code reading of CL_IDFI_CGI_CALL05_GENERIC->GENERIC_CALL line 108-115 shows the LOOP writes <fs_fpayp>-ref01+0(60) = ls_adrc-street where ls_adrc was loaded via get_company_address(zbukr) — i.e. PAYING-CO address, not vendor. Under this code path, the matrix-row-1 binding would render UNESCO HQ street as <Cdtr><StrtNm>. Empirical 2026-05-07 BERTOLDINI test rendered VENDOR street ('BFM/FAS/PAY') under V001, which is inconsistent with the matrix-row-1 design.
candidate_explanations: (A) The actual V001 binding deployed to D01 SEPA tree differs from matrix-row-1 — the deployed binding uses FPAYH-ZSTRA (vendor street Z-field) directly, and the matrix row 1 is forward-design only.
(B) FPAYP-REF01 layout for SEPA differs from FPAYHX-REF01 for CGI — but matrix row 1 says they're identical (CM005 line 109 cite).
(C) There's another code path that overwrites FPAYP-REF01 with vendor data after GENERIC_CALL (e.g. a BAdI or another Event).
verification_plan: (1) RFC-extract DMEE_TREE_NODE WHERE TREE_ID='/SEPA_CT_UNES' AND VERSION='001' for node N_3513093480 (per matrix row 1) — read MP_SC_TAB and MP_SC_FLD.

(2) If (1) returns MP_SC_TAB=FPAYP, MP_SC_FLD=REF01, then trace the V001 BERTOLDINI F110 run on 2026-05-07 — check whether SAPFPAYM_MERGE bypassed CGI_05 entirely (using ZSAPFPAYM_REPLAY path) which would explain a different REF01 population.
(3) Examine ZSAPFPAYM_REPLAY's FPAYHX/FPAYP construction — does it call FI_PAYMEDIUM_DMEE_CGI_05 or pre-populate REF01 from REGUH/FPAYH-ZSTRA?
blocks: Phase 5 V001 SEPA cutover — must not release until matrix row 1 vs code reality is reconciled

issue: JCDS (object status change history) not loaded. JEST (current status) IS present. JCDS = the status TRANSITIONS (created->released->completed->closed) for orders/PS/PM/QM, decoded via TJ02T. NOT captured by CDHDR/CDPOS.

resolution_path: Extract JCDS (OBJNR,STAT,UDATE,UTIME,USERID,CHGNR) + TJ02T (status texts). Pairs with existing JEST. Priority 2 after CDPOS. Verified by deep research (van der Aalst/RWTH, SAP KBA 3527846).

issue: Golden DB provenance is AMBIGUOUS for 2 tables. The stated rule is 'a bare table name means P01', but bare SKB1 holds 2,312 rows for ONE company code (UNES) with 41 columns, while P01_SKB1 holds 9,249 for ALL NINE with 38 columns. Bare SKAT=7,485 vs P01_SKAT=7,473. Anyone reading SKB1 as production GL data silently gets an eighth of it.
impact: silent partial reads on GL company-code data; any analysis keyed on SKB1 is under-scoped
fix_path: decide which extract is authoritative per table, then either drop the bare one or rename it with its real provenance. Do NOT auto-resolve: the bare SKB1 has 3 EXTRA columns, so it is not simply a subset.

issue: 10 SAP objects have a 0-byte file in the extracted corpus. All of them are members of one function group — the custom payment-medium family under Zagentexecution/extracted_code/FI/YFPAYM_full/: Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_06, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_101_00, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_101_06, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_101_21, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_101_40, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_101_41, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_21_FILE_RENAME, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_41, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_DMEE_30, Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_NOTE_TO_PAYEE. The extraction ran, wrote empty files, and reported nothing. Among them is Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_NOTE_TO_PAYEE, the FM that builds the SWIFT :70 note-to-payee (EXO//reason//XBLNR//) — directly load-bearing for the Egypt purpose-of-payment question, where the requirement is literally 'populate SWIFT Field 70'.
impact: We believe we hold this code and we hold nothing. Any analysis that greps the corpus for these FMs returns zero and reads as 'the logic does not exist' — the exact failure that produced claim 116. Not theoretical: it already happened once.
why_it_hid: The first version of the inventory grouped objects on any shared token, so these ten were merged onto Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_101_30.abap (535 lines) and reported as healthy 535-line objects. Restricting grouping to RARE tokens exposed them.
fix_path: Re-extract from P01 via RPY_FUNCTIONMODULE_READ_NEW (function group YFPAYM), or from D01 via ADT, into the corpus. BLOCKED as of 2026-08-17: P01 unreachable (WSAETIMEDOUT 172.16.4.100:4800, VPN down). Verify after re-extract with `python brain_v2/graph_queries.py code_gaps` — EMPTY must go to 0.
resolution: RECOVERED same session. VPN returned; all 10 FMs re-read from P01 via RPY_FUNCTIONMODULE_READ_NEW into extracted_code/FI/YFPAYM_full/ (0B -> real source, 17..103 lines each). Verified by reading Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_NOTE_TO_PAYEE end to end. FINDING BEYOND THE RECOVERY: the note-to-payee is NOT built as EXO//reason//XBLNR// as the sap_payment_bcm_agent skill states — the string EXO does not appear in ANY of the 10 recovered sources. The FM reads custom table YVENDOR_PAYM_REF keyed (BUKRS, LIFNR, BLART) and writes FPAYP-ZREF01; when no row exists it falls back to a format chosen by FPAYHX-PREFTYP: SAMPLE 01 -> No.<xblnr>/<bldat>, SAP SEPA -> /INV/<xblnr> <bldat>. Y_FI_PAYMEDIUM_06 and _DMEE_30 read the same table.

issue: 52 objects have their only real source OUTSIDE the golden corpus, and 3 have a STUB at the canonical path while the body lives elsewhere. There are two different trees named `extracted_code/` — one at the repo root and one under Zagentexecution/ — so the same folder name means two places. The load-bearing cases: CL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_FALLBACK CM003 (2,406 lines) and CM004 (1,893) — the DMEE BAdI core — plus YRGGBS00 (1,593 lines, UTF-16) and FI_CGI_DMEE_EXIT_W_BADI.
impact: Looking an object up by its canonical name returns the stub and lets you believe you have read it. This is what made claim 116 possible.
fix_path: Decide ONE canonical root, then adopt the real bodies into it (copy, never move or delete — feedback_never_delete_extracted_code). Until then the inventory makes it SAFE: `graph_queries.py code <obj>` always returns the largest body with its encoding, whichever tree it sits in.

issue: El campo 'caveats' de cada research es un STRING PLANO en 8 de las 9 investigaciones cerradas (medido: 1998-2327 caracteres cada uno; la 9na, wegppc001_egypt_ppc_iso20022.json, sigue un schema distinto sin campo caveats), mientras que 'findings', 'refuted' y 'openQuestions' del MISMO fichero son LISTAS. No es corrupcion de datos -- el contenido del string es legible y correcto (prosa de advertencia de alcance) -- es una INCONSISTENCIA DE TIPO dentro del mismo schema.
impact: Un consumidor que trate los 4 campos de forma uniforme (por ejemplo iterando 'for c in research[campo]' asumiendo que todos son listas, como findings/refuted/openQuestions) recibe 2050 (o 1998/1664/...) entradas de UN caracter al iterar 'caveats' en vez de un bloque de texto. Hoy NINGUN script en brain_v2/ o process_mining/ accede a la clave 'caveats' (grep 0 hits, 2026-08-27) -- es un riesgo LATENTE, no un defecto ya manifestado en ningun artefacto generado.
detected_by: Inspeccion manual de tipos (2026-08-27): findings=list, refuted=list, caveats=str, openQuestions=list en los 9 ficheros de brain_v2/research/.
fix_path: Decision del propietario del research loader: (a) dejar 'caveats' como prosa deliberada y documentar el contrato para que ningun consumidor futuro lo trate como lista, o (b) migrar los 9 ficheros a 'caveats': [str, ...] por consistencia estructural con los otros 3 campos. Ninguna opcion se aplico aqui -- el steward no redisena el schema de un store sin evidencia de que el defecto ya ocurrio (CP-003); se deja registrado para quien construya el primer consumidor de 'caveats'.
